cards.label: DeskHub emulator
cards.subtitle: High-performance emulation with Rust Vulkan 1.3 core
cards.body:
WHAT'S NEW IN DESKHUB EMULATOR v1.0.5
• Upgraded to version 1.0.5
• Direct-to-Display Native Vulkan 1.3 Renderer
• Zero-Copy AHardwareBuffer frame pipeline
• Aggressive CPU offloading & asynchronous processing
• Persistent VkPipelineCache on NVMe/UFS storage
• Low-latency kernel input loop
• Offline play & clean isolated environment
